title: OpenAI收购Pierre Computer Company以优化AI编码代理的Git协作
originalTitle: OpenAI acquires Pierre Computer Company to make Git keep up with AI coding agents
summary: OpenAI收购Pierre Computer Company以优化AI编码代理的Git协作。Pierre的Code Storage和工具（Trees文件导航、Diffs代码对比、Highlights实时语法高亮）将整合到OpenAI的Git系统中，帮助开发者和AI代理协同工作。收购需监管批准，Pierre的开源项目将继续保持开源状态。
